summary: Frontend-focused regression retest on public preview URL completed. Clipboard-denied copy flows no longer crash and show toast feedback; tools/mobile support smoke flows pass. Desktop Home nav still fails strict deterministic top reset (scrollY remains 7-9px).

ui_bugs.issue: From lower sections, clicking Home leaves residual scroll offset (scrollY 7-9px) instead of exact 0 across repeated checks.

action_items: Fix desktop Home navigation to guarantee exact top reset (scrollY === 0) on desktop across repeated clicks.
Retest desktop-nav-home after fix using repeated lower-section cycles.
critical_code_review_comments: App.jsx is 718 lines (>700 guideline); split into focused modules/components to reduce regression risk.
Home scroll logic currently gets close to top but not deterministic exact-zero under automation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated on https://ai-prompt-studio-51.preview.emergentagent.com. Clipboard denied simulation via overridden navigator.clipboard.writeText passed for Prompt and Hook copy (toast shown, app interactive). Mobile drawer, bottom Support modal, and tools tab switching passed. Remaining blocker: desktop Home nav leaves small residual offset (7-9px) after repeated cycles from services section.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: Desktop viewport 1920x1080 -> click desktop-nav-services -> click desktop-nav-home, repeat 3x. Observed window.scrollY stays 7-9px after 1.75s. Likely cause is current home branch forcing scrollTo(0,0) while CSS smooth-scroll/style restoration/layout timing leaves residual root scroll. Mitigation direction: enforce exact post-frame normalization (e.g., chained requestAnimationFrame/setTimeout zeroing and verify final root/window positions) before restoring smooth behavior.
